record_scope_reconstruction: Rason ordinary tourist access through the same Quanhe–Wonjong gateway was suspended again. No COVID rationale is inferred for the March 2025 reversal and exceptional business/delegation travel remains separate.

source_checks.finding: March 5 dated operator instruction suspends Rason tourism immediately; reason and duration unknown.
June 16 selected Chinese tourism-industry visitors were not tourists; general tourism still shut.
October 1 2026 operator update distinguishes limited Russian arrangements from other ordinary international tourists.

sites.name: Quanhe–Wonjong tourist road crossing area
sites.coordinate_method: Arithmetic mean of mapped OSM way vertices from fresh XML, approximate crossing-area marker (not survey centroid): way/931730588
sites.precision: Crossing-area reference, 500 m; old/new parallel bridges share this gateway but precise lane used on every date is not established.
sites.evidence_note: OSM name Old Tumen River Bridge/Alte Quanhe-Wonjong-Brücke identifies the historical road crossing. Tour operator explicitly names Quanhe–Wonjong access, and its guide depicts tourists using the old bridge.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: Ordinary foreign land tours to Rason via Quanhe–Wonjong, through the operator's June update.
